content.text:
I finished the worktree change and merged it. The voice assistant is deployed and works.

**Deployment** (`https://pawse-114215092948.europe-west6.run.app/app/`)
- `/app/` serves the React voice app, and the Mimi page (`/`), `/api/v1/health` and `/api/v1/demo/mimi` all return 200.
- `/api/v1/voice/status` says Gemini, Gradium and Live are all configured (model `gemini-3.8-live`).
- I asked the deployed service for a Gemini Live session token and it returned one (201). That's the step the voice call needs to start.
- ⚠️ For a few seconds around 14:24 UTC every route returned `400 Invalid host header`. Someone else deployed two new versions at that moment, and the newer one set `PAWSE_ALLOWED_HOSTS` to the two run.app hostnames. Since then it's fine. If you put a custom domain in front of it later, add that domain to `PAWSE_ALLOWED_HOSTS` or every request will get the same 400.

**Worktree (`pawse-wt-web`): finished, merged as https://github.com/yyyuanfish/pawse/pull/54**
- **Dropped:** the Dockerfile changes. Main already builds the React app inside the image, so they were redundant.
- **Kept:**
  - The "☏ Phone assistant" link to `/app/` in the Mimi page sidebar. Main had no link to the voice app from that page.
  - A `.dockerignore` fix that leaves out `.env` files in subfolders too. Before, only the root one was ignored, so a `web/.env.local` would have been copied into the image build and its `VITE_` settings built into the public app.
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passed: 117 tests, 6 skipped.
- I deleted the old stash, the worktree and its local branch.

⚠️ I didn't redeploy, so the new sidebar link only goes live with the next deploy from main. Another session is deploying right now and I didn't want to overwrite their version. Want me to redeploy from `origin/main` once they're done?
